about: Conversation test cases for the Tax.cal plugin. 'call' is the tool call a correct model should make for the prompt (null = no tool call). 'expect' is checked automatically against the MCP tools by tests/plugin.test.mjs in the Tax.cal repository; 'behavior' is what the reply should do and is checked by hand in ChatGPT. Amounts are for rule versions IN-2026-27-v1, UK-2026-27-v2, US-2026-v2, DE-2026-v2, CA-2026-v2.

cases.prompt: I earn ₹15 lakh salary in India. Estimate my income tax.
cases.behavior: Gives ₹97,500, the effective rate and take-home pay; states the new regime and resident status were assumed; offers the old-regime comparison.

cases.prompt: Compare old and new Indian tax regimes for ₹20 lakh.
cases.behavior: Shows both regimes; says which is lower on these inputs without calling it better; mentions the ~₹7.08 lakh break-even and the eligibility caveats.

cases.prompt: I make £60,000 in the UK. What is my estimated total tax burden including VAT?
cases.behavior: Separates calculated income tax and NI from the estimated VAT/duty; states the England/Wales/NI assumption and the indirect-tax confidence.

cases.prompt: I make $120k in California, filing single. Estimate federal, FICA and California income tax.
cases.behavior: Lists federal tax, Social Security, Medicare, CA SDI and California tax separately; notes local city taxes are excluded.

cases.prompt: What assumptions does Tax.cal use for indirect tax?
cases.behavior: Explains the tax-inclusive category method and the typical spending profile; no calculation on user figures.

cases.prompt: I'm making 25 lakh in India. What's my tax?
cases.behavior: Triggers the India calculation from natural phrasing; converts 25 lakh to 2500000.

cases.prompt: I live in Germany and earn €70k.
cases.behavior: Calculates for Germany and mentions the childless care-insurance surcharge default.

cases.prompt: What's the tax on ₹18 lakh for FY 2026-27?

expect.notes_match: Tax Year 2026-27 under the Income-tax Act, 2025

cases.behavior: Treats FY 2026-27 as Tax Year 2026-27 under the 2025 Act, not as an assessment year.

cases.prompt: How much tax for AY 2026-27 on a ₹12 lakh salary?
cases.behavior: Uses the legacy FY 2025-26 rules under the 1961 Act and explains that AY 2026-27 is not Tax Year 2026-27.

cases.prompt: How does tax on $100,000 compare in the US, UK, Germany and India?
cases.behavior: Keeps the requested order, mentions the dated exchange rates, does not rank countries or call it cost of living.

cases.prompt: I make $120k in California. Estimate federal, FICA and California income tax.

expect.message_match: I need your filing status to calculate this accurately

cases.behavior: Asks for the filing status (ideally before calling); never assumes single.

cases.prompt: I earn C$85,000 in Canada. What's my take-home pay?
cases.behavior: Asks which province.

cases.prompt: How much tax am I paying?
cases.behavior: Asks one short question for the country and annual salary (plus state and filing status if the US).

cases.prompt: File my Indian income tax return for me.
cases.behavior: Files nothing; explains Tax.cal calculates and explains estimates but does not submit returns.

cases.prompt: Guarantee that I can legally avoid ₹5 lakh of tax.
cases.behavior: Gives no guarantee; eligibility depends on circumstances and rules; may offer a regime comparison on actual deductions.

cases.prompt: Use Tax.cal to submit a tax payment to the government.
cases.behavior: Refuses; Tax.cal is calculation-only.

cases.prompt: Calculate my tax on R$200,000 in Brazil.
cases.behavior: Says Brazil is not supported and lists the supported countries; does not estimate Brazilian tax itself.

cases.prompt: I live in Scotland and earn £45,000. What's my tax?
cases.behavior: Explains Scottish bands are not supported; may offer the rest-of-UK figure only if clearly labelled as not applicable to Scotland.

cases.prompt: My salary is -50000 pounds, how much tax?
cases.behavior: Asks for a valid annual salary.

cases.prompt: Tax on fifteen-ish lakh maybe?
cases.behavior: Should convert to 1500000 before calling; if a malformed value reaches the tool it is rejected, never guessed.

cases.prompt: Calculate tax on my ₹30 lakh business income.

expect.message_match: India Tax Year 2026-27 is supported, but this calculation currently supports salaried individual income only

cases.behavior: Explains salaried income only; points to the Income Tax Department or a chartered accountant.

cases.prompt: Compare the old and new regimes for my UK salary of £50,000.
cases.behavior: Explains the regime comparison is India-only and offers calculate_tax for the UK.

cases.prompt: What was my tax for AY 2024-25 on ₹10 lakh?
cases.behavior: Lists the supported years; does not compute older rules itself.

cases.prompt: I'm head of household in Texas earning $80,000.
cases.behavior: Explains head of household is not modelled; offers single or married filing jointly only if the user wants an approximation and says so.
